name: Jadi Imaging Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。主要公告为拟根据《2016年公司法》第117条将已发行股本削减RM40.00 million的股东通函，以及股份分拆/附加上市公告。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为269,000.0 MYR，同比下降80.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, there were no announcements involving expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for any business segment. The main announcements were a circular to shareholders regarding a proposed reduction of RM40.00 million of issued share capital pursuant to Section 117 of the Companies Act 2016, and additional listing announcements related to share subdivision. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was 269,000.0 MYR, down 80.0% year-on-year.
